findings.problem: Model-as-printed/column mismatch: the column named on the candidate is 'Kimi K2.5' (the 5th cell of the header row = 76.8), while the registry row is for Kimi K2.6 and the value 76.8 is the Kimi K2.5 column, not this model's column. The printed model identity for the value is Kimi K2.5, not Kimi K2.6.

Ambiguous-duplicate-column value: the row prints the identical value 69.3 in both the Qwen3.5-27B and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B columns, so on the printed evidence alone the cell position does not uniquely identify which product the 69.3 belongs to.
